title: Right adjoint commutes with direct sums
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is perfect, meaning of finite Tor dimension: for every x\in X the local ring \mathcal O_{X,x} has finite Tor dimension as an \mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}-module (for a morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes this is the Stacks notion of a perfect morphism, under which \mathcal O_X is locally perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] relative to Y), and let c be a right adjoint to the derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on the quasi-coherent derived categories D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. Then c commutes with all set-indexed direct sums: for every family (K_j) in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y) the canonical map \bigoplus_j c(K_j)\to c(\bigoplus_j K_j) is an isomorphism.
